Discovery highlights:
- Primary ask: large-language-model features to power operator console assistant + rapid manual lookup of maintenance SOPs and anomaly triage.
- Absolute constraint: data cannot leave customer network; no outbound model fallbacks to hosted endpoints.
- Preference for open/quantized model (4-bit/8-bit) that can run on certified on-prem racks; willing to test Redwood private bundle and a smaller quantized fallback only if packaged and locked in air-gapped image.
